question: A linear programming problem has the constraints $x+y=6$, $x+2y\le10$, $2x+y\le10$, $x\ge0$ and $y\ge0$. Representing a point satisfying $x+y=6$ as $P(t,6-t)$, determine all values of $t$ for which $P$ is a feasible solution and hence obtain the optimal feasible solution that maximises $Z=2x+5y$.
